name: Lee's Pharmaceutical Holdings Limited
summary: Lee's Pharmaceutical Holdings Limited is an investment holding company that develops, manufactures, markets and sells drugs in China, Hong Kong and internationally. Its focus areas include cardiovascular disease, women's health, pediatrics, rare diseases, oncology, dermatology and obstetrics. Its proprietary and generic segment makes products such as Nadroparin Calcium injection and Socazolimab, while its licensed-in segment markets treatments such as Sancuso, Bredinin and Intrarosa.
